//: PIKIS backend API. Attach a Postgres service that ships pgvector and set DATABASE_URL=${{Postgres.DATABASE_URL}}. VERIFY BEFORE FIRST DEPLOY: SELECT * FROM pg_available_extensions WHERE name='vector' -- migration 0001 fails loudly if absent. Deploy in SINGAPORE to match Vercel sin1, or every streamed token makes two trans-Pacific hops. Needs >= 1 GB RAM (torch + e5 + BM25 artifact is ~700MB-1GB RSS); 2 GB recommended. Set JWT_SECRET, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CORS_ORIGINS (exact Vercel origins). The `serve` role also HOLDS THE DAILY CRAWL SCHEDULE (01:00 CRAWL_TIMEZONE, in-process) -- no cron service is required. If you would rather bill per running minute, deploy railway.ingest.json as a second service on a cron and set CRAWL_SCHEDULE_ENABLED=false here, or the corpus gets harvested twice.

deploy.//: ALWAYS: this is a server, an exit is a fault -- and since the crawl schedule lives in this process, a service that stays down also stops harvesting. numReplicas 1 -- each replica holds its own in-process BM25 artifact and its own copy of torch; two replicas double memory for throughput this workload does not need, and each would run its own scheduler (harmless -- the runner's advisory lock refuses the second -- but pointless).
deploy.//healthcheck: 300, not 120: startup imports torch and loads the BM25 artifact before /health answers, and a transient DB blip on first boot (init_db retries these now) can eat a minute of the window before the app even starts.
